mint_method.summary: free mint at value 0; Sourcify-verified source; minted ERC721 #1087 on 2026-11-04, gas 0.00001862 BNB

notes: The clean case: verified source, free, simulation passed before signing, mint executed cleanly.

failure_reason: Mint contract source NOT verified (the project's own FAQ admits it; Sourcify has no match) while the separate token contract IS verified. quoteFor(wallet,1) read 0 and freeMintAvailable read 1 on-chain, but eth_call mint simulation reverted. Not executed 2026-11-04.

mint_method.summary: first share claimed free on-chain in theory; in practice the minter could not be read or simulated - blocked

notes: The blocked case: unverified source + reverting simulation = hard stop, even when the price reads free.

failure_reason: totalSupply reached 3333/3333; mint() simulation from the wallet reverted - allocation exhausted
notes: Lesson: check totalSupply vs cap and simulate before believing any 'still open' post.

failure_reason: claimFee() = 0.00023342 BNB anti-Sybil fee (NOT gas-only) and the wallet held 0 qualifying Series I NFTs

mint_method.summary: claim per held work NFT; claimOpen() was true

notes: Lesson: always probe claimFee()/fee() - a 'free claim' with an anti-Sybil fee is not free.

mint_method.summary: first mint per Agent ID free (gas only) through the project launch flow; the token contract itself exposes NO mint function

notes: Lesson: do not expect mint functions on a token CA - the mint can live in a separate flow.
